Oliver — ran the first burst series this morning. Quick summary (attached full CSV + dashboard snapshot):
- Burst profile: ramp 0 -> 2200 req/s over 10s, hold 30s, ramp down 10s.
- Observations:
  - For bursts <= 800 req/s: system absorbs load with p95 ~ 220ms, TTFT ~ 110ms, no queueing beyond short scheduling delay (~15-25ms).
  - Bursts 800-1500 req/s: transient queueing appears; queue depth peaked at ~420 requests; p95 rose to 480ms during peak; <0.5% 429s (client-shielded rate-limits kicked in).
  - Bursts >1500 req/s: sustained queue growth; p95 exceeded 1.2s for ~20s; observed retry amplification in our harness when retries were aggressive.
- Recommendation (initial): configure client-side concurrency cap = 150, token rate cap = 500k tokens/min per API key, implement exponential backoff + full-jitter for retries.

Oliver / team — steady-state runs completed and analysis attached. Executive summary for procurement (one pager included):

Executive summary (short):
- Steady-state targets: 30-minute windows at concurrency 50 / 150 / 300 / 600.
- Results (avg across steady windows, 256-token avg prompt):
  - Concurrency 50: p50 38ms, p95 160ms, TTFT 92ms, sustained throughput ~120 req/s
  - Concurrency 150: p50 44ms, p95 210ms, TTFT 100ms, sustained throughput ~370 req/s
  - Concurrency 300: p50 63ms, p95 420ms, TTFT 130ms, sustained throughput ~680 req/s
  - Concurrency 600: degraded tail behavior: p95 1.05s, TTFT 210ms, throughput plateaued at ~1.2k req/s with ~0.9% 5xx/429 mix during hot windows

Acceptance review vs your SLO (p95 < 500ms):
- Up to concurrency 300 we meet p95 < 500ms. Concurrency 600 exceeds your p95 target intermittently.

Queueing behavior notes:
- Short bursts cause scheduling jitter (sub-200ms) which is acceptable. Sustained overload produces long queues and tail amplification; client retries without jitter can make this worse.

Recommendations (final MAP items):
- Production client caps: concurrency = 150 per API key; secondary cap of 600 as a pooled account limit with coordinated throttling for internal services.
- Rate limits: token rate = 500k tokens/min per API key; enforce soft-429 with Retry-After header when approaching soft limits.
- Retry/backoff: exponential backoff with full jitter; initial retry-delay = 100 ms, max retries = 3 for idempotent calls.
- Monitoring & alerts: p95 > 500ms sustained for 5m should trigger escalation to infra and fallback to shorter responses or degraded models.

Deliverables attached: concurrency_test_results.csv (full time-series), dashboard_snapshot.png (time-series view), 1-page summary (in MAP workbook), SLA_exception_request.pdf (permission to reserve burst capacity above 150 for short windows during onboarding).
